program_scope: One frozen Python program; this is not the interactive-investigation condition. Fresh condition model/context; no donor-session fragments or cross-condition reuse.

native_environment.image: Exact externally admitted sha256 digest; no pull/install path
native_environment.producer_memory: Explicit independently admitted selection; no observed feasibility claimed

resource_limits: Explicit whole-run read/write/retained/free-floor/OTHER limits and original clock, plus independent observer reserve. Products are source-derived reservations and components, not measured wall/RSS/physical I/O. No source cap or workload is silently reduced.
input_contract: program/index.py produces metadata from all108 authenticated original prepared records and an authorized in-memory key. It does not read a key or neural file. Index contains no online labels; external full source/channel/onset/finite/support and opaque row provenance must be admitted.
fit_infer: Exact original monolithic opaque row order, training-only view then retired training mount and fresh query-only view plus sealed model. Permitted training labels may be retained inside model.
method_gate: Independent source/exposure admission must establish no query adaptation and training-only tuning. A readonly model is not a universal proof. Method receipt binds the entire selected configuration except its own descriptor.
score_gate: Separate trusted root-selected external proof, captured worker/reference/source/selection, both full output collections and both original scorer admissions precede one protected target callback. Only original primary and contrasts plus separately named candidate-minus-reference comparison.
grade_clock: Cooperative checks before/after protected targets and before return; hard cutoff requires separately qualified enclosing process. Protected callback private I/O/resources have a separate trusted allowance.
